profile.headline: Software Developer at Macquarie Group
profile.summary: I'm currently a full-time software developer at Macquarie Group LTD in the Houston office.

positions.title: Executive Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Java · PostgreSQL · MongoDB · gRPC · Scala

positions.title: Full-Stack Java Developer | Working onsite at Macquarie
positions.description: This position is a contractor from Wiley Edge in Macquarie Group Limited. My responsibilities include working with Java and Scala to implement features, working in a team using SCRUM, working with databases, and working with support team members on issues.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Mongo · Kubernetes · Spring Framework · Scrum

positions.title: Rodis Community Helper
positions.description: Rodis is a gathering place on the Discord platform for users of Roblox to chat; to help and get help on developing games on Roblox; and to gather friends to play games together. Rodis currently has 460k+ users worldwide. I voluntarily assist users on issues in Roblox, such as restoring the website when their cache loads the website wrong and I also assist users in filling in the support form with finding what to information to add and how to format the questions; and I assist users in developing games, such as explaining what methods can be used and how to use them in design and scripting Roblox games. I spend about 10 hours a week answering questions and supporting users. Helping and working with others on Rodis helps me improve my skills in teaching and coding in all languages

positions.title: Trainee
positions.description: Training to be a Full Stack Java Developer
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Thymeleaf · Spring Framework · SQL

positions.title: Food Delivery Driver
positions.locationName: Pizza Stop, South Plainfield, New Jersey
positions.description: During the summer of 2019, I worked at a nearby small pizza shop to deliver pizza, answer calls, wash dishes, and clean the floors before closing.

positions.title: Counselor in Training
positions.locationName: 219 St Nicholas Ave, South Plainfield, NJ, US
positions.description: During the Summers in 2013 to 2016, I worked at a Summer camp to take care of children from 1st grade to 8th grade. I worked at least 40 hours a week to watch the kids, play games with the kids, run errands for counselors, and do chores such as cleaning and setting up for lunch.

projects.title: Yum
projects.description: Programmed an application to run a small stock market simulation through the Discord social platform • Studied how to use JavaScript Express, SQLite, and Discord.js • Hobby project to practice JavaScript and using SQL from 01:198:336, Principles of Information and Data Management, at Rutgers • Helped me learn how to use databases in practice

projects.title: Potato Simulator
projects.description: Led the programming in a game on the Roblox game platform • The Game was showcased on the front page on Roblox for a week and was played by different users on Roblox 300k times since 2017 • Practiced working in a team of different skillsets to accommodate one another • Strengthened understanding of the language, Lua
